name: The Ties That Bind
label: Quest
description: The Ties That Bind: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.
One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.
Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are our brethren's lives truly worth so little to you, Haalien?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. No matter how much rage I have within me, it would have been difficult to strike down my own cousin.
Do not mourn for him. His ignorance and malice has killed many innocents this day.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
